level.title: B1 Intermediate Telugu
goals: Use Telugu script with romanisation and accurate English meaning.
Adapt language to age, relationship, context, and register.

lessons.title: Health and Wellbeing — B1
lessons.learn: Connect narration, reasons, opinions, obligations, and conditions in independent everyday communication. This lesson applies that progression to health & doctor.

grammar.title: Health and Wellbeing structures
grammar.explain: Connect narration, reasons, opinions, obligations, and conditions in independent everyday communication. Telugu keeps the finite verb near the end; case, tense, respect, and clause links are commonly carried by suffixes.
grammar.pattern: context + case-marked participants + object/complement + finite verb
mistakes: Do not copy English word order or remove Telugu suffixes; keep the complete model and choose a respectful form for elders and formal settings.

practice.q: Produce the complete Telugu expression: I am not feeling well
Say naturally in Telugu: My head aches
